objective: Establish the permanent Qwen3.8-27B CPU prompt-prefill and decode tokens-per-second baseline without weakening correctness gates

admission_gate.node_exclusivity: No QAT, cache, quality-evaluation, inference-server, or other throughput process may share the node

measurements.authoritative_metric: llama-bench avg_ts with all five raw samples retained

validity_rules: Every result row must bind the exact 27B artifact and runtime binary
CPU masks select one hardware thread from each physical core before SMT is explored
All expected 12 rows must exist: nine prefill and three decode
Each row must contain exactly five finite positive samples
This baseline is descriptive and does not itself promote a runtime change
Any later speed promotion requires identical model bytes, valid quality receipts, at least 5 percent paired median gain, and no authoritative pair below 1.0x
